root_cause.text: The PTP worker introduced by commit 7c01dbfc8a1c5f to cache PHC time is not stopped before freeing adapter resources (e.g., Admin Queue) during reset or disable, causing a use-after-free race when the worker accesses freed memory/locks.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message state: "Commit 7c01dbfc8a1c5f ('iavf: periodically cache PHC time') introduced a worker to cache PHC time, but failed to stop it during reset or disable. This creates a race condition where `iavf_reset_task()` or `iavf_disable_vf()` free adapter resources (AQ) while the worker is still running." The patch adds `iavf_ptp_release(adapter);` calls in both `iavf_disable_vf()` and `iavf_reset_task()` before the resource cleanup, ensuring `ptp_clock_unregister()` synchronously cancels the worker.

intent_record.intent_summary: Release PTP resources when disabling VF to prevent resource leak during PF communication failure.
intent_record.what: Added a call to iavf_ptp_release(adapter) inside iavf_disable_vf() after setting IAVF_FLAG_PF_COMMS_FAILED flag.
intent_record.how: Ensures that PTP resources are released when a VF is disabled, particularly in the case of PF communication failure, preventing resource leaks and stale state.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add call to release PTP resources during adapter reset to ensure proper cleanup and avoid resource leaks or state corruption.
intent_record.what: Added a call to iavf_ptp_release(adapter) in the iavf_reset_task function, placed after clearing the reset pending flag and before freeing Tx/Rx rings and descriptors.
intent_record.how: During an adapter reset, the driver now releases Precision Time Protocol (PTP) resources prior to freeing rings and descriptors, ensuring that any PTP-related hardware or software state is cleaned up as part of the reset sequence.

The root cause identifies that the PTP worker must be stopped before such cleanup to avoid use-after-free. The absence of any worker cancellation in this reset/disable path (lines 1787-1834) means the vulnerable construct is present and the fix is not yet applied.
